outcome: APGAR scores at 0 and 5 minutes post-birth
cohort: The study included 502 participants aged 17-59 years (mean 32.23 years) undergoing cesarean section procedures due to clinical necessity at an obstetrics and gynecology department.
finding: The study found average APGAR scores of 7.02 at 0 minutes and 7.84 at 5 minutes, indicating generally favorable immediate neonatal outcomes following cesarean section.
